boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, documented study environments centered on Collins Memorial Library.

cards.title: To the Heights
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Head to the fourth floor when you need a quiet setup; the library identifies To the Heights as a quiet study space with views.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor quiet-study area with views.
cards.evidence_claim: Collins Library identifies To the Heights as its fourth-floor quiet study space and notes its views.
cards.source_title: Dr. Annie Downey extends a warm welcome to all!
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor of Collins Memorial Library; verify current library building access before visiting.

cards.title: First Floor Reading Rooms
cards.subtitle: Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use the first-floor Reading Rooms for a light-filled reading session; library staff describe these rooms as spaces full of art and light.
cards.short_summary: Reading rooms shaped by art and daylight.
cards.evidence_claim: The library describes its first-floor Reading Rooms as beautiful spaces full of art and light.
cards.source_title: Dr. Annie Downey extends a warm welcome to all!
cards.access_notes: Inside Collins Memorial Library; confirm current building hours and access policies before arrival.

cards.title: Rocking Chair Nook
cards.subtitle: Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Bring a reading assignment to the Rocking Chair Nook, which the library specifically presents as a place to rest or read a book.
cards.short_summary: A named nook for a quieter reading break.
cards.evidence_claim: Collins Library identifies the Rocking Chair Nook as a place to rest or read a book.
cards.source_title: Dr. Annie Downey extends a warm welcome to all!
cards.access_notes: Inside Collins Memorial Library; check current building access and keep the space suitable for reading.

cards.title: I-Commons
cards.subtitle: First floor, Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Choose I-Commons when your work needs a computer: this first-floor area combines information and computing services in one location.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor computing and research workspace.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists I-Commons among Collins Library's work and study spaces; its library tour places it on the first floor.
cards.access_notes: First floor of Collins Memorial Library; workstation availability and building access may vary.

cards.title: Collins Creative Center
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Set up in the Collins Creative Center when a project needs making or printing; the library places this creative resource on its lower level.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level space for creative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Collins Library identifies the Collins Creative Center on its lower level and says it includes the Makerspace and Printing Press Studio.
cards.source_title: Dr. Annie Downey extends a warm welcome to all!
cards.access_notes: Located on the library's lower level; consult the library for current service and equipment availability.

cards.title: Printing Press Studio
cards.subtitle: Lower level, Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use the Printing Press Studio as a project-focused change of scene; it is one of the creative spaces named by Collins Library.
cards.short_summary: A named studio within the lower-level Creative Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies the Printing Press Studio as part of the lower-level Collins Creative Center.
cards.source_title: Dr. Annie Downey extends a warm welcome to all!
cards.access_notes: Located on the library's lower level; check current studio access, supervision, and equipment procedures.

cards.title: Library 146
cards.subtitle: Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Reserve Library 146 for a small group session outside peer-advising use; the room has two large monitors for laptop connections.
cards.short_summary: A reservable group-study room with two monitors.
cards.evidence_claim: Collins Library states that Library 146 is bookable as group study space outside evening peer research advising and has two large monitors.
cards.source_title: Collins Library Links: Spring Research Services
cards.access_notes: Bookable for up to two hours outside evening peer research advising; verify the current reservation system and schedule.

cards.title: Library 017
cards.subtitle: Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Consider Library 017 for a technology-supported work session; the university lists a Zoom Room with HDMI and wireless ShareLink.
cards.short_summary: A 20-person library room equipped for Zoom and sharing.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists Library 017 as a 20-person Zoom Room with HDMI, wireless ShareLink, and Zoom.
cards.access_notes: Technology-equipped library room; confirm room availability, class scheduling, and any reservation requirement before use.

cards.title: Library 053
cards.subtitle: Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use Library 053 for a larger collaborative work session when available; its listed setup includes a PC, Blu-ray, and laptop connection.
cards.short_summary: A 24-person room with PC and display options.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists Library 053 as a 24-person room with HDMI laptop connection, Blu-ray, and a PC.
cards.access_notes: Technology-equipped library room; confirm room availability, class scheduling, and any reservation requirement before use.

cards.title: Library 054
cards.subtitle: Collins Memorial Library
cards.notes: Plan a focused group work block in Library 054 when it is open; the university lists it as a 16-person room with HDMI connection.
cards.short_summary: A 16-person library room with HDMI connectivity.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists Library 054 as a 16-person room with an HDMI laptop connection.
cards.access_notes: Technology-equipped library room; confirm room availability, class scheduling, and any reservation requirement before use.
